kills.property: For any owner-issued Command(address,bytes), the reference always performs exactly one external call to adr regardless of the payload, so a recording callee's call counter becomes 1; the mutant removes the external call entirely, so the counter stays 0 and the rule fails for every input.
kills.change_summary: Remove the external call so no value is forwarded and data is never executed.
